cycles.method: No static count and no event counter (waived by the owner, sdk/approvals). On the unit, 26 November 2026, 16 locks with the crossfader sweeping left the frame interrupt at 28.5 % against 28.5 % without the module, and no render was skipped (TESTING.md).

load.method: Hardware, not cfmeter: the owner's MKII on the development twin 8fd6d456 of base 0.8.1, 26 November 2026, package 17f934ff (0.3.1). The owner's loaded project (bank G, pattern 1) playing, the crossfader swept end to end every 250 ms for 8 s. Without the module, then with it and 16 scene locks (T1-T8, encoder A, scenes A and B): the frame guard's longest frame interrupt (56.4 % and 57.2 % of a frame; its share 28.5 % both) and the CPU meter (44.4 % and 44.2 %; idle taken as 100 less the meter) (TESTING.md).
